title: Steve's review page: approve its new screen words so it can be built?
bluf: Tap a and the review page build starts. Your own words 'Run idea / feedback past Steve' go in exactly as you wrote them. The page needs about twenty short new lines, all listed below: the page title 'Feedback for review', the Approve and Delete buttons, a delete confirmation, a message to the person who sent the item ('Saved, held for review'), and the empty and error messages. One thing to look at: several lines name 'Datasec's Jira board' on screens HP people will see. Option b drops that name.

options.label: Approve all as proposed
options.detail: The builder uses exactly the lines listed in the facts below; nothing else new appears on screen. Then a strict check before anything lands; not deployed.

options.label: Approve, but say 'Jira' instead of 'Datasec's Jira board'
options.detail: Same lines, with every 'Datasec's Jira board' shortened to 'Jira'.

options.label: I will reword some (type them in the note)
options.detail: Nothing is built until your wording is in; I apply it word for word.

default_action: If you never answer, nothing is built: the page waits for your words.
facts: 1 Category (yours): 'Run idea / feedback past Steve', first in the list.

2 To the sender after a held submit: title 'Saved, held for review'; body 'Thank you. Your feedback is saved in the Playbook and held for review. It goes on to Datasec's Jira board only if it is approved.'
3 State word and filter, for Admins: 'Held for review'.

4 Page: title 'Feedback for review'; lead 'Items sent with Run idea / feedback past Steve wait here. Approve sends one on to Datasec's Jira board. Delete removes its text for good.'; admin index link 'See the feedback waiting for review'; loading 'Loading the feedback for review...'.
5 Buttons: 'Approve', 'Delete'; confirm 'Delete this feedback? Its text is removed for good.' with 'Delete' and the existing 'Keep it'; busy 'Approving...', 'Deleting...'.

6 Results: 'Approved. It will go to Datasec's Jira board in the next few minutes.' (sending on); 'Approved. Saved, not yet sent.' (sending off, as on the review site today); 'Deleted. The text is gone for good.'

7 Empty and errors: 'Nothing is waiting for review.'; 'Only the Admin role can review feedback.'; 'This item is no longer waiting for review.'; 'The service answered with an error (n).'; 'Choose review, bug, idea, content or question.'
8 Reused, already on screen: 'Keep it', 'Saved, not yet sent', 'From the <role> role on <page>'.
Source: the builder kit's word pack, Tuesday's brief folder 2026-11-03_B1206_DRAFTER-REPORT.md.
